title: l1qw.25.2: C: wire Schnorr48 verify-before-rebroadcast in SOS rx path
description: Spec R-12-034/035: SOS messages MUST carry a valid link-layer signature verified at each receiving node before rebroadcast; unsigned/invalid silently dropped. The verify path exists (Schnorr48 in link layer) but is not called from the SOS receive path. Wire sos_resource.c to verify the link-layer signature of incoming SOS frames before accepting or relaying. Python reference: emergency.py:232-251 auth. Test vectors: sos_signature.json.
